_comment: Web Studio — composer `scripts` for a PHP project (stack-reference/php.md). Merge into composer.json; `composer ci` is what CI runs and what /story-done and /refactor read. Pick the `lint` and `stan` lines of the tools recorded in technical-preferences (php_cs_tool, php_static_analysis). A script may not be named like a built-in Composer command (`audit`, `validate` — Composer skips it), and built-ins are called as `@composer …`. `composer validate --strict` requires `description` and `license` (e.g. `proprietary`) in composer.json.
